figures.name: Väinämöinen

ability.name: World-Song
ability.description: Sing the world: reset all enemy stat bonuses to their original values.

figures.description: Primordial shaman-bard born from the cosmic waters who shapes reality through the power of song and rune.

figures.name: Ukko

ability.name: Ukko's Hammer
ability.description: Strike all enemies for 4 thunder damage; allies gain +2 defense for 1 turn.

figures.description: Supreme sky and thunder god of the Finns who grinds storms together in his millstone to make rain.

figures.name: Louhi

ability.name: Mistress of the North
ability.description: Seal one ally ability and one enemy ability; both remain sealed until Louhi leaves the field.

figures.description: Powerful witch-queen of the icy north who commands ten thousand warriors and steals the sun and moon.

figures.name: Ilmarinen

ability.name: Eternal Sampo
ability.description: Forge a divine artifact: all allies regenerate 2 HP per turn for 3 turns.

figures.description: Eternal divine smith who forged the sky itself and hammered out the magical Sampo that brings prosperity.

figures.name: Lemminkäinen

ability.name: Reckless Charge
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one target; this card takes 3 reflected damage from overconfidence.

figures.description: Reckless hero who romances every woman, charges into every danger, and is resurrected by his devoted mother.

figures.name: Tapio

ability.name: Forest Lord's Favor
ability.description: Ally hunter cards gain +4 power; enemies with beast type lose 2 power.

figures.description: Lord of the forest whose blessing determines whether a hunt succeeds and who must be asked permission to hunt.

figures.name: Ahti

ability.name: Net of the Deep
ability.description: Trap one enemy: they cannot switch positions or use escape abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: Ancient sea deity and lord of the waters whose blessing fills fishermen's nets.

figures.name: Mielikki

ability.name: Bear's Healing Paw
ability.description: Heal all allies for 3 HP; bears and nature creatures gain +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Forest goddess and mistress of bears who presides over healing and the luck of all hunters.

figures.name: Loviatar

ability.name: Nine Diseases
ability.description: Inflict a random disease on one enemy reducing a random stat by 3 for 2 turns.

figures.description: Blind daughter of Tuoni who bore nine disease spirits and spreads suffering across the world.

figures.name: Surma

ability.name: Death's Maw
ability.description: If an enemy is below 3 HP, devour them instantly and gain +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Monstrous dog-beast that guards the gates of Tuonela, the land of the dead, devouring all who try to return.

figures.name: Tuonetar

ability.name: Black River Draught
ability.description: Poison one enemy for 3 turns; the antidote costs one of the enemy's abilities.

figures.description: Queen of Tuonela who serves the river of the dead and prevents the living from returning from the underworld.

figures.name: Otso the Bear King

ability.name: Sacred Bear Form
ability.description: Gain bear form: +3 power and defense for 2 turns; immune to fear effects.

figures.description: Heavenly bear lowered to earth in a pine cradle who is revered as a divine ancestor spirit.

figures.name: Ajatar

ability.name: Plague Coil
ability.description: Spread disease to all enemies: each loses 1 HP per turn for 3 turns.

figures.description: Dragon-like pine forest spirit that nurses serpents and spreads plague to all who encounter her.

figures.name: Kokko the Eagle

ability.name: Great Wings
ability.description: Carry one ally to safety; return them next turn with full HP restored.

figures.description: Giant eagle of the sky who carries Väinämöinen across impossible seas and aids great heroes on their quests.

figures.name: Tursas

ability.name: Tursas Surge
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; destroy all field buffs and debuffs.

figures.description: Primordial sea monster summoned from chaos who assisted in the creation of the world.

figures.name: Päivätär

ability.name: Golden Thread
ability.description: Grant one ally immunity to dark effects for 1 turn; restore 2 HP.

figures.description: Sun maiden who weaves golden cloth on the arc of heaven and guides travelers through the day.

figures.name: Kuutar

ability.name: Silver Web
ability.description: Reflect the next special ability used against any ally back at the attacker.

figures.description: Moon maiden who weaves silver cloth on the arc of heaven, sister of Päivätär.

figures.name: Pellervo

ability.name: Sowing Song
ability.description: At start of each turn, restore 1 HP to all allies for 2 turns.

figures.description: First farmer of the world who sowed trees on the hills and fish in the waters at the beginning of time.

figures.name: Hiisi

ability.name: Hiisi's Curse
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's power by 3 for 2 turns.

figures.description: Malevolent forest spirit and embodiment of evil whose name is given to all dangerous wild places.

figures.name: Tuulikki

ability.name: Animal Call
ability.description: Summon a small beast ally with 4/4/4/4/4 stats for 1 turn.

figures.description: Daughter of Tapio the forest god who manages the wild animals and aids hunters who show proper respect.
